Claim.description:
SourceClaim (spec section 18): one value read from one source, with its span and the
exact excerpt there, as an agent labelled it (label review: not run, requires human).
Claim.title: Claim

FundingInstrument.description:
A funding scheme's rules (spec section 18, FundingInstrument): never a conclusion about
a person's eligibility (spec section 11), so its award state is always `not_assessed`.
FundingInstrument.title: FundingInstrument

JobPosting.description:
One source's copy of a vacancy (spec section 18, JobPosting); copies of one vacancy
share `vacancy_id` and count once.
JobPosting.title: JobPosting

LearningOption.description: The stable syllabus and provider (spec section 18, LearningOption).
LearningOption.title: LearningOption

Offering.description: A dated offer of an option (spec section 18, Offering): intake, fees, timetable.
Offering.title: Offering

Outcome.description:
A planned outcome row, `PlanAction.outcomes` (OUT-1): never demonstrated competence.
A level needs a rubric and an assessment that supports it; otherwise null.
Outcome.title: Outcome

Review.description: A person's recorded decision on a record (H-07, session 2), as Task 7c transcribes it.
Review.title: Review

RightsClass.description: The session 1 rights policy's classes (H-06), as the evidence records name them.
RightsClass.title: RightsClass

Skill.description:
A pack-local requirement row a target's postings share (`pack:<target>:<row>`); Task 9
maps rows to ESCO and gives them rubrics.
Skill.title: Skill

SkillRequirement.description:
A requirement row from a posting (spec section 18, SkillRequirement). A posting states
no behaviourally anchored level, so `required_level` stays null until a reviewed rubric
(Task 9) sets it.
SkillRequirement.title: SkillRequirement

Source.description: One corpus page (`corpus/manifest.json` slot) as it was retrieved.
Source.title: Source

Span.description: Offsets into the hashed page text, or a JSON pointer into an API response.
Span.title: Span

Split.description: Assigned by template family before any tuning (OI-09): never tune on holdout.
Split.title: Split

Unknown.description: Why a field has no value: never zero, empty or a guess.
Unknown.title: Unknown

DurationPart.description: One way of taking it (full time, part time, self-paced) and how long it lasts.
DurationPart.title: DurationPart

instalment.description: A payment plan: an amount per period, a number of payments, or both.
instalment.title: Instalment

pay.description: Advertised or provider-predicted pay: a range, a point (equal ends) or one bound.
pay.title: Pay

rate.description: An amount per period: a yearly fee, a yearly grant.
rate.title: Rate

schedule.description: A working or study pattern: an offering's schedule, a posting's working pattern.
schedule.title: Schedule
